form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for Er:YAG laser resurfacing with clear differentiation from CO₂. Strong emphasis on the reduced thermal damage and faster healing. Good guidance on the precision ablation characteristics and realistic expectations.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is specifically for Er:YAG LASER resurfacing (2,940nm wavelength). Er:YAG is absorbed 10x more by water than CO₂, creating precise ablation with minimal thermal damage. Faster healing but less collagen stimulation than CO₂.

instructions.general_directive: Follow for 5-10 days of care, with faster recovery than CO₂. Er:YAG offers precision with reduced downtime.

sections.title: Er:YAG vs. CO₂ Differences
sections.content: Er:YAG (2,940nm) vs. CO₂ (10,600nm): 1) More precise tissue removal 2) Less thermal coagulation 3) Less collagen stimulation 4) Faster healing 5) Less prolonged redness.

sections.title: Immediate Er:YAG Response
items: Pinpoint bleeding (more than CO₂) due to precise ablation.
Faster re-epithelialization (5-7 days vs 7-14 for CO₂).

sections.title: Er:YAG Healing Timeline (Faster)
items: Days 1-3: Pinpoint bleeding stops. Moderate redness.
Days 7-10: Pink, smooth skin. Makeup possible.
Weeks 2-4: Pinkness fades quickly compared to CO₂.

sections.title: Skincare for Er:YAG
items: Sun protection critical but less prolonged than CO₂.

sections.title: Realistic Er:YAG Expectations
items: Results: Excellent for surface texture, mild-moderate wrinkles.
Less dramatic for deep wrinkles/scars than CO₂.
Often requires multiple treatments for optimal results.
Excellent for: Perioral lines, eyelid wrinkles, delicate areas.
Combination approach: Er:YAG for precision + CO₂ for thermal effect.
